turns.text: M1 is the ABHA identity milestone: creating an ABHA number, logging a person in, reading and updating their profile, downloading the ABHA card, and the gateway session and token calls everything else depends on. Most of these APIs are mandatory for both private and government integrators; Aadhaar demographic authentication is the exception, mandatory only for government integrators.

must_contain: M2 is the milestone for sharing records as a HIP
turning your records into FHIR bundles and grouping them into care contexts
linking those care contexts to a patient's ABHA address
answering discovery requests, then encrypting and pushing data when consent allows
notes: follow-up asks for the M2 counterpart of an M1 answer; the second answer is m2.md's own summary and plain-words text.
